notes: Medium (sum 11): five distinct log-processing competencies bundled into two runnable programs (jsonl group-sort + equal-thirds round partitioning; stack-trace-to-frames parsing with prefix/:: stripping; IP-presence-gated last-date regex extraction; and an incident tool with IPv4 validation + cross-log dedup). The agent must specify exact deterministic formats (raw-line preservation for rounds, line-number row keys, JSON schemas, exit codes) that the verifier then revalidates by re-running /app/logproc.py and /app/respond.py on fresh hidden inputs, including malformed JSON lines, duplicate microsecond timestamps, invalid-octet IPs, empty-report targets, and invalid-IP rejection (non-zero exit + marker). Reasoning depth and quantitative correctness come from the aggregate-thirds round partition and dedup/sort semantics; hidden_case_generalization captures the runnable-on-new-inputs contract across four hidden scenarios.
